assign.label: Add a coach
assign.heading: Coaches
assign.description: Every coach listed here sees all of this player's practices and can log new ones. Each coach can change only the practices they logged themselves, and completed practices keep the name of the coach who led them.
assign.noCoaches: No coach to assign to. Invite one first.

errors.playerNotInOrg: This player does not belong to the organization.
errors.failed: The change could not be saved.
errors.nothingSelected: Select at least one player and one coach.
errors.confirmRemove: Confirm that planned practices of the removed coaches will be cancelled.

assign.allAssigned: Every coach of the organization is already assigned.
assign.removeConfirm: Remove {name} from this player? Their planned practices with this player will be cancelled. Completed practices stay.

team.title: Coaches
team.seatsFull: All seats are taken. Remove a coach to free one up.
team.inviteDescription: Create a code and send it to the coach (SMS, e-mail...). They enter it once in the app and you'll see them here.
team.playersCount: {count, plural, =0 {no players} one {# player} other {# players}}
team.removeNote: Their players and practices stay with the organization — assign them to another coach in the panel afterwards.
team.inactiveNote: A removed coach frees up their seat but keeps their history. Bring them back and they pick up where they left off; delete them and only this entry disappears — their players and practices stay with the organization.
team.reactivateConfirm: Bring {name} back into the organization? They will take up a seat again.
team.deleteConfirm: Permanently delete {name} from the list? This cannot be undone. Their players and practices stay with the organization.

errors.inviteFailed: Failed to create the invite code.
errors.reactivateFailed: Failed to bring the coach back.
errors.reactivateHasPersonalData: This coach now manages their own players outside the organization, so they cannot be brought back. They need to archive those players first.
errors.reactivateMemberElsewhere: This coach has meanwhile joined another organization.
errors.reactivateCoachAccountRequired: This account is not a coach account, so it cannot be brought back into the organization.
errors.seatLimitReached: All seats are taken. Free one up first.
